sentence_label.instructions: Classify how the Japanese rule-document sentence in `sentence` is written, taking the sentence literally as written. Decide only by the grammatical shape of the main operation, not by whether the content is good advice.

prescriptive.includes: A plain affirmative imperative that states the operation to perform. Scope words inside the object noun phrase. A when/if clause that modifies a noun (relative clause) or a negative adjective inside the object noun phrase. Manner-only negation such as 'without doing X', where the main verb is still affirmative.
prescriptive.neighbor_belongs_elsewhere: If the whole operation is gated by a when/if clause the agent must judge first, it is conditional. If the main verb is negated or forbidden, it is prohibitive.
prescriptive.example: Write a comment under the definition line of every function you added or changed.

conditional.includes: The main operation is gated by a condition clause meaning 'when X happened', 'in the case of X', 'if X', 'once X is done'. A table-style row '<event that occurred> | <operation>'.
conditional.neighbor_belongs_elsewhere: A when-clause that only modifies a noun inside the object does not gate the operation: prescriptive. A line that merely quotes a conditional wording to show its rewrite: not_a_rule.
conditional.example: When you wrote a task list, update the index in the same operation.

prohibitive.includes: The main operation is negated or forbidden: 'do not', 'never', 'forbidden', 'must not', 'NEVER'. A prohibition restated as an affirmative verb of avoiding or holding back.
prohibitive.neighbor_belongs_elsewhere: Negation only inside a noun phrase or only as manner is prescriptive. A prohibition with a stated reason is rationale. A quoted prohibition shown only as a rewrite source is not_a_rule.
prohibitive.example: Do not write cases; write failure types.

rationale.includes: A reason, background, history or consequence. A statement of fact or causation instead of an instruction. An instruction with a reason attached by 'because' or 'so that'. A record of a past event.
rationale.neighbor_belongs_elsewhere: A plain instruction with no reason attached is prescriptive, conditional or prohibitive according to its main operation.
rationale.example: A memory that is not listed in the index is never loaded.

not_a_rule.includes: An example line starting with the word for 'Example:'. A list of links to related memory files. A rewrite-mapping line that quotes a prohibitive or conditional wording only to show what it should become.
not_a_rule.neighbor_belongs_elsewhere: A sentence that gives an instruction in its own voice, even about examples, is not here.
